svg.title: LEFT JOIN LATERAL ... ON true keeps airlines whose subquery returns nothing
svg.desc: Each of 4 airlines gets its own run of the subquery, which returns that airline's flights sorted by dep_delay, largest first, with LIMIT 2. American returns f4 and f7, Delta f6 and f2, United f8 and f1 (f5 and f3 are cut by LIMIT 2), and Hawaiian returns 0 rows. With LEFT JOIN LATERAL ... ON true, the result has 7 rows: two per airline with flights, plus Hawaiian with NULL flight and dep_delay.
svg.text: LEFT JOIN LATERAL ... ON true keeps airlines whose subquery returns nothing
The subquery still runs once per airline. An empty run keeps the airline, with NULL in the subquery's columns.
Hawaiian stays, with NULL in the columns
ON true: the matching already happened
Struck-out rows were cut by LIMIT 2.
